about: Character art made with Higgsfield (model gpt_image_2_5, quality medium, resolution 1k unless a request says otherwise, background transparent: 0.5 credits an image at 1k, 1 at 2k). Each request is one image; tools/import_generated.py cuts it into the named sprites, matching figures to outputs left to right. refs are the reference images given to the model, in order.

references.ref_bodies: npc_walt, npc_maya and player_idle side by side on white: style, proportions and pose
references.ref_faces: face_walt_neutral, face_maya_content and face_june_gentle side by side on white: portrait style and framing
references.<name>_body: the generated full-body image of that character: keeps the portraits consistent with the sprite
references.ref_items: item_coffee_mug, item_teacup, item_picnic_basket, item_camera and item_novel side by side on white: item style
references.ref_player_poses: art/source/player_poses.png on white, 1280 px: the player character's look, style and scale
references.ref_furniture: art/source/furniture.png on white, 1280 px: furniture style (linework, texture, three-quarter view)

style: See the prompts: every request asks for the game's hand-painted style (ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading) and a transparent background.

requests.prompt: A new character for the same 2D game as the reference image, drawn in exactly the same hand-painted style as the reference characters: fine dark-brown ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading with subtle speckles, warm muted palette, the same semi-realistic proportions, head size and line weight. scenes.about: Backgrounds repainted from the existing ones: the current background (window glass white, padded at the bottom to the model's aspect ratio) is the composition reference, so the painting lands on the same coordinates. gpt_image_2_5, quality medium, resolution 4k (1.25 credits). Import with: python3 tools/import_scene.py <name> <image>.

laundromat.reference: laundromat.webp (the fire extinguisher by the door painted out), padded with floor to 2880x1234
laundromat.prompt: Repaint this side-scrolling 2D game background — the empty interior of an old neighbourhood laundromat, back wall and floor seen straight on — as a rich hand-painted storybook illustration: fine dark-brown ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading with subtle paper grain, a warm, slightly worn, lived-in look, soft warm daylight. Keep EXACTLY the same composition, proportions and positions as the reference image: the pressed-tin ceiling strip along the top with a thin electrical conduit, the four teal enamel pendant lamps hanging at the same places, the pale mint-green beadboard upper wall, the wooden chair rail, the cream square-tile wainscot below it, the teal-and-cream diamond checkerboard floor seen in perspective, the wooden door at the far left with a small plaque reading UPSTAIRS and the small sign above it reading ATTENDANT / on duty 8-6, the empty dark-green chalkboard in a wooden frame (leave it completely blank, no writing at all), the long back window with three panes, the five copper water hook-ups with one red and one blue tap each, spaced evenly along the wall, the two silver dryer vent ducts coming down from the ceiling on the right with the small sign reading LINT / clean traps between them, the tall shop-front window on the right with a low wooden ledge along its bottom, the glass front door at the far right with a PUSH plate and a small brass bell above it, the WELCOME doormat by the door and the round floor drain. Every window pane and the glass of the front door and its transom must stay pure flat white (#FFFFFF) with nothing seen through them, no reflections, no curtains and no lettering. Add gentle painterly detail: scuffs and chips on the tiles, faint water stains, worn paint, a couple of electrical outlets. Do NOT add any washing machines, dryers, furniture, tables, benches, shelves, plants, posters, clocks, people, animals, or any other text.

home.reference: home.webp with the painted bed replaced by wall and floor, padded with floor to 2100x1181
home.prompt: Repaint this side-scrolling 2D game background — the inside of a small, cosy, slightly shabby studio flat above a laundromat, seen straight on — as a rich hand-painted storybook illustration: fine dark-brown ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading with subtle paper grain, warm muted colours, soft warm light. Keep EXACTLY the same composition, proportions and positions as the reference image: the dark wooden ceiling beams along the top, the faded rose striped wallpaper with small dots, the wooden wainscot panelling along the bottom of the walls, the warm honey-coloured wooden floorboards seen in perspective, the plain wooden front door at the far left, the peg rail with a teal and an orange tea towel, the small kitchenette with a white tiled splashback, a two-ring hob and a small sink, the teal painted cabinets under a worn wooden counter top, the wall shelf above it with jars and tins, the big six-pane window in the middle with rust-red curtains tied back on both sides, the round pendant lamp hanging in front of the window, the teal cushioned window seat with a mustard and a rust cushion, the radiator under it, and the wall shelf of books on the right. Every glass pane of the window must stay pure flat white (#FFFFFF) with nothing seen through it: no sky, no buildings, no reflections. Keep the right third of the room empty: plain wallpaper and wainscot with bare floorboards in front (a bed will be placed there later). Do NOT add any bed, table, desk, chair, stool, rug, plant, picture frame, lamp, person, animal or text.
